job.title: Senior Java Developer - E-Commerce + Accounting & Marketplaces - remote in EU

tailoring.headline: Senior Java Developer | Spring Boot, REST APIs & Microservices | E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Java Developer - E-Commerce + Accounting & Marketplaces
cover_en.hook: I am very interested in the Senior Java Developer - E-Commerce + Accounting & Marketplaces role at pathway solutions, as it aligns closely with my background. I bring over 5 years of professional experience building, extending, and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: Java & Spring
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management.

bullets.label: RESTful APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and built RESTful APIs and OCC Web Services for Headless Commerce integrations and PWA frontends.

bullets.label: Database & SQL
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, supported by strong SQL and FlexibleSearch optimization skills.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integration
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub, and investigated integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and Profisee platforms.

cover_en.gap: While my core expertise is rooted in enterprise e-commerce platforms, Java, and backend integrations rather than specialized accounting systems and marketplaces, I am keen to learn and expand my skill set in these areas.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I will be available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background fits your team.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at pathway solutions because of your innovative approach to e-commerce and technical platforms. My 5+ years of backend development experience with Java, Spring, and enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell position me to contribute effectively to your remote engineering team.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated to apply my backend expertise in Java, Spring, and enterprise e-commerce platforms to help pathway solutions build robust, scalable solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I applied for the Senior Java Developer role. With 5+ years of backend and e-commerce experience in Java and Spring at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would love to bring my expertise to pathway solutions. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Java Developer - E-Commerce + Marketplaces - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Java Developer - E-Commerce + Accounting & Marketplaces position. With over 5 years of backend experience in Java, Spring, and enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to support your team. I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026, and can start on 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
